QUOTE: "This states what the index covers: file count, whether the scope was declared or derived from the whole repo, the extensions and top-level directories, and excludes."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The scope block lists the extensions the index covers. The answer never says the reply names the in-scope file types that produced no rows, so it doesn't show "not in the repo" apart from "that file type isn't indexed" in the way the item requires.
